Q5651.reason: An 'as is' clause cannot override the seller's express representation of the model year, which Carol relied on, so she can likely recover.

Q5672.reason: If the man's shooting was justified by self-defense, no crime was committed, so the defendant has no derivative accomplice liability; insanity and diminished capacity are personal and don't bar the instigator's liability.

Q8537.reason: A value-neutral definition keeps the question of whether punishment is justified open rather than settling it in the definition.
